external_games.name: Shelves and Sorcery - Too Many Potions!

name: Shelves and Sorcery: Too Many Potions!
summary: This DLC adds a fourth shop to the relaxing fantasy organization game: an eccentric alchemist’s potion shop at the edge of the world. Restore order to more than 3,000 bottles, with every shelf able to hold any potion. Organize by color, appearance, or your own system, and tidy the shop at your own pace.
